snippet.title: Ghosts of the Mountain Pass | Racing RPG Videogame | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Ghosts of the Mountain Pass on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5272470/Ghosts_of_the_Mountain_Pass/
The Italian Riviera, the tail end of the 1990s. A race that ended decades ago, but never quite died.
Ghosts of the Mountain Pass is a single-player racing RPG. Challenge local rivals in head-to-head duels where distance is damage, win parts from the drivers you beat, and build a car part by part that you can truly call your own.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5272470/Ghosts_of_the_Mountain_Pass/
Follow development on Discord: discord.gg/9aQCnUUvwg
